Name: Emily the Mixologist - Cocktail and Mocktail Shop and Special Orders
Author: AirynS
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/JBY2sue.png[/img]
[size=4]﻿
An expansion of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18717][size=4]HxW Mixology 101 [/size][/url][size=4]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108124018]Himetarts [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url], this mod expands on Emily's job at the Stardrop Saloon by making her a mixologist and bartender with her own shop selling drinks.

Initially starting off with a small selection of alcoholic & non-alcoholic drinks, Emily asks for your help via special orders for HxW ingredients to help her expand her menu. Once she has a full menu on offer, townspeople will start posting special orders for HxW drinks!

Like HxW Mixology 101, either cocktail or mocktail content can be disabled, but Emily the Mixologist includes bonus content & additional synergy if both are enabled.

To start the first special order, you'll need to see Emily's initial event, which is available after having unlocked the special orders board. Visit the saloon in the first week of the season any time while Emily is there.

[img]https://imgur.com/XrWdUgj.png[/img]﻿

[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Two new shops selling alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks from Himetarts and Wildflour![/size]
[*][size=4]Five special orders to expand Emily's shops over time[/size]
[*][size=4]35 special orders available after completing Emily's shop expansion[/size]
[*][size=4]Four new events: two related to the shop expansion and two reward events for particular special orders[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[img]https://imgur.com/0R7biKQ.png[/img]﻿
[/size][size=4]
To install, first make sure that you have the required mods installed:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18717]Mixology 101 [/url]﻿(install both for best effect)[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods ﻿[/url]﻿(required for Mixology 101) [/size]
[/list][size=4]Next, simply extract the "Emily the Mixologist" folder and drop it into your Mods folder!

Although not required, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9693]Daily Special Orders [/url]is strongly recommended for use with this mod, particularly if also installing other mods that add new special orders, so that it is easier to find the shop expansion orders.

[img]https://imgur.com/v0kYolw.png[/img]﻿

Emily the Mixologist has two configuration option:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]ShopOnly[/b]. Set this to "true" if you only want the HxW drinks to be sold at the saloon directly without unlocking them over time and don't want special orders.[/size]
[*][size=4][b]CocktailsOrMocktails[/b]. Set this to "CocktailsOnly" if you don't want mocktail content, "MocktailsOnly" if you don't want cocktail content, or "Both" if you want both cocktails and mocktails. For best effect, match this to the corresponding option in Mixology 101's config.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/EirFN0t.png[/img]﻿[size=4]

Emily the Mixologist is confirmed to be compatible with the following mods:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url] - If installed, Emily the Mixologist will adapt to LUTI's tweaked saloon map[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17775]Part of a Saloon Breakfast [/url]﻿- If installed, Emily the Mixologist will add an additional plate icon to indicate where Part of a Saloon Breakfast's all-day breakfast shop can be accessed next to Emily's drinks menus. Emily's shop icons are also designed to match Part of a Saloon Breakfast's shop icon and although they don't reference each other content-wise, they can be considered complementary mods.[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village [/url]﻿﻿﻿- If any or all of these mods are installed, one of Emily the Mixologist's special orders will account for the increased number of people living in or visiting Pelican Town.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Special Sunberry Village Compatibility
[/b]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village [/url]is installed, then Emily the Mixologist will have brand-new exclusive additional content! This includes:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]6 new Sunberry-themed drinks![/size]
[*][size=4]4 new special orders[/size]
[*][size=4]2 new events[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Emily the Mixologist has [i]not [/i]been tested with SVE. [b]Compatibility is unknown and will not be provided[/b]. Comments asking for or complaining about SVE compatibility will be deleted.

[img]https://imgur.com/AGO2GKm.png[/img]

[/size][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18223]Yri's Retro Recolor[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17912]VPR-Inspired UI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url][/size][/size]
[/list][size=4] [/size][img]https://imgur.com/2X2oKN4.png[/img]﻿[size=4]
[/size][size=4]
Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108124018]Himetarts [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url] for their blessing to create this add-on in the first place, their encouragement along the way, and to Hime for use of her glass sprites for the Sunberry drinks, and to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/skellady/about-me?gameId=1303]skellady [/url]and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sophiesalacia/about-me?gameId=1303]sophie [/url]for their help and encouragement in creating the Sunberry content! <3 Thanks as well to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92469153]Arknir [/url]for event tips & tricks and to all of my friends in the modding community for their support and encouragement. Hope you enjoy the mod![/size]
